propositions: The wheel-probe CI step must walk and import every rebar.* subpackage module to catch import-time breakage missed by the existing probe (entry-point help calls and JSON-resource walk only)

Scripts that perform bare-import statements without guaranteed sys.path setup fail in isolation but pass when sibling scripts mask the missing insert via process-wide sys.path mutation, hiding the regression
Top-level scripts must be imported in isolated child processes to enforce the documented standalone import contract and prevent sibling sys.path inserts from masking missing dependencies

Optional-dependency modules (rebar._mcp_auth under [mcp], rebar.opcert_service.app and rebar.review_bot.app under [reviewbot]) must be attempted but recorded as expected skips only when the declared dependency is absent
The check must report all import failures in a single run (non-failing fast) and remain locally runnable with no CI infrastructure dependency
